[SWS_DM_00065] Always supported availability of the group of all DTCs
⌈
The DM shall provide by default the DTC group ’GroupOfAllDTCs’ assigned
to the DTC group identifier 0xFFFFFF. This DTC group contains always all configured
DTCs.
⌋
